notes.title: New ARPG mode
notes.content: [p]This is the final update for this game, and its content will serve as the base version for the new game.[/p][p]Additional features will be gradually added and optimized in the new game.[/p][p]Since this mode will be migrated to Unreal 5 in the future, the character creation system has been temporarily disabled in this mode.[/p][p]To prevent clipping issues with weapon handling, the maximum chest size for characters is now limited to the default size in the new mode.[/p][p]This update introduces an ARPG + survival crafting open-world mode.[/p][p]The game code has undergone significant modifications and optimizations to improve gameplay feel (applicable only to the new mode; the main story mode remains unchanged).[/p][p]New content includes but is not limited to:[/p][p]Revamped animation state machine for smoother player controls[/p][p]New weapon-wielding and melee combat animations[/p][p]Content currently available in the new mode:[/p][p]Building mode (basic functionality; more building types will be added later)[/p][p]Leveling and skill-point allocation system[/p][p]Scavenging and material breakdown system[/p][p]Weapon crafting and repair system[/p][p]Quest system (preliminary storyline, unrelated to the future full version)[/p][p]Shop system[/p][p]Companion system[/p][p]Execution system[/p][p]Fast-travel system (requires activation at designated teleport points)[/p][p]Upgraded map system (more detailed, with new objective markers and navigation guides)[/p][p]Souls-like melee combat system:[/p][p]Jumping and dodging/sidestepping[/p][p]Crouching removed[/p][p]New weapons: scimitar, greatsword, bow, and a movable axe (recommended for early game)[/p][p]Enemies include two existing types with new AI (new enemies will be created in Unreal 5, expanding beyond zombies)[/p][p]Save mechanism changed to instant auto-save (only for this new mode)[/p][p]Additions:[/p][p]1 new boss[/p][p]2 new outfits[/p][p]Future plans include vehicles and various new systems.[/p][p]Note: The current map is a temporary setup with limited exploration content, which may feel repetitive.[/p][p]A new Unreal 5 demo will be released later; those not in a hurry to test may wait for future content.[/p]

notes.title: Add 2 new gameplay modes: rougelike and Soul like BOSS Battle
notes.content:
1: When a regular enemy hits a hard line, they can perform hook lock and kick (automated, if blocked, no kick will be performed, limited to arena maps)
2: Fixed a malicious bug where duplicate custom keys can disrupt array sorting
3: Fix elevator sound bug caused by custom sound effects
4: Add a new map of 30 wave rougelike mode to the arena
5: Add new boss battle map (soul like mode)
6: Fix elevator sound bug caused by custom sound effects
7: Two new clothing items and one new pattern item each

notes.title: March 19th Update
notes.content:
New UI map guide (opened with M key)
Cancel the power outage operation of the elevator between the water plant and the medical area
Fix the bug in AI restoration of hospitals and water plants with default normal difficulty after exiting the game
Reduce the lock in period of 20% for the corrupt experimental body's punching punch (simple vs. normal mode)
Fix collision issues in the scene
Repair the black lace sock fitting mold
Repair the bunny girl jacket wearing mold
Fix the lens zoom bug caused by quick aiming with the right mouse button

notes.title: February 29th Update
notes.content:
Increase the rate of head burst damage for each difficulty level

Increase the protagonist's running speed by 10%

Fix the bug where the storage box is empty

Fix a bug where custom buttons (Reload) are invalid
